description.zh:
AI模板详细配置，JSON字符串。
具体配置，请参见[AITemplateConfig](~~89863#title-vd3-499-o36~~)。
description.en: The detailed configurations of the AI template. The value must be a JSON string. For more information, see [AITemplateConfig](~~89863#title-vd3-499-o36~~).
The name of the AI template. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.

description.zh:
AI模板类型。取值：
- **AIMediaAudit**：智能审核。
- **AIImage**：智能封面。
description.en:
The type of the AI template. Valid values:

- **AIMediaAudit**: automated review.
- **AIImage**: intelligent thumbnail.

descriptions.zh:
- 目前本接口支持的服务地域：**华北2（北京）**、**华东2（上海）**、**新加坡**。
- 添加智能审核和智能封面任务需要使用的AI模板前，请确保已开通[智能审核](https://ai.aliyun.com/vi/censor)或[智能封面](https://ai.aliyun.com/vi/cover)。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is supported in the following regions: **China (Beijing)**, **China (Shanghai)**, and **Singapore**.
- Before you add an AI template for automated review and intelligent thumbnail tasks, make sure that you have activated [Automated Review](https://ai.aliyun.com/vi/censor) or [Intelligent Thumbnail](https://ai.aliyun.com/vi/cover).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod add-ai-template --template-name AI-media-test --template-type AIMediaAudit --template-config AuditItem_:_terrorism_,_porn_,_AuditRange_:_image-cover_,_text-title_,_video_,_AuditContent_:_screen_,_AuditAutoBlock_:_yes --region cn-hangzhou
